description: 충청남도 하천수 수질측정망 현황 [dams, reservoirs and flood defences] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 충청남도. 하천·호소·지하수 등 수자원 현황과 수질 측정 결과, 수생태계 관련 정보, 물관리 정책 및 계획 자료를 연계·제공함으로써 지역별 물환경 현황을 종합적으로 파악할 수 있다. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
